name: Cogito Snacks #10
description:
A small paper bag containing hexagonal, lightly sweetened crackers. Each cracker presents a distinct walnut-like flavor enhanced by an unfamiliar undertone. Consumption results in transiently increased intelligence and problem-solving ability.

EFFECT: Eater experiences brief enhancement of cognitive functions, including memory recall and problem-solving skills.
ANOMALOUS PROPERTIES: Consumption induces temporary heightened cognitive abilities, improving clarity in thought and recollection for approximately thirty minutes.
TASTE: Mildly sweet with subtle hints of walnut and a curious undertone resembling fresh paper.
PACKAGING: A simple paper bag with a faded olive green color scheme, featuring abstract patterns reminiscent of mid-century modern design.

RESEARCHER NOTE: Ironically, they make solving 1960s crossword puzzles much easier.

Dispensed by SCP-261 on 2026-11-04 — edition #10 of the permanent record.
